reviews.title: Great case - but's packed like a can of sardines!
reviews.comment:
So this case is about 33% smaller than my last ITX case. Everything fit, but just barely. It took much longer than I anticipated to build, and there is no way I am opening up and swapping components. I literally threw away all the extra wires, etc... and I sent back two Nocturna fans - because there was literally zero extra room.
That being said, so far there have been no problems with it running hot, which I attribute to the liquid CPU cooler and placement of the video card.
This is also not the case if you want RGB lights. The video card and the liquid cooler block almost all the light coming through.
My build was:
1. AMD Ryzen 9900X
2. CoolMaster V850 SFX gold (you have to use SFX power)
3. ARTIC Liquid Freezer III Pro A-RGB - 240m. RGB was wasted, and it's really thick. I wish I had gotten something thinner. It barely fit in there, and I had to jury-rig it slightly to make it work.
4. Samsung 990 4T
5. Cosair Vengance DDR5 64G 6000Mhz
6. ASUS TUF GeForce 5070 12G
7. Gigabyte B850i ITX
reviews.author: JTH

reviews.title: Good quality case.
reviews.comment: High quality case made with great material. Had to return it since it didn’t fit my GPU. Fit length wise but it was too thick slot wise. And made my GPU sag by a few mm. The case closed but I could see the sag. Cable management was good because I was able to fit in the cables neatly but still sad on the last step the GPU didn’t fit.
reviews.author: radyumi

reviews.title: Awesome ITX case
reviews.comment: Awesome case. Looks clean, and I was able to fit my ASUS Tuff Gaming 4080 Super (348mm) paired with a Ryzen 9 7950X3D and an ID Cooling 240mm AIO. The temps are great, around 48°C on my GPU and around 60-65°C for the CPU while gaming.
reviews.author: ALEXANDRA GUARECUCO

reviews.title: Incredible case for the price.
reviews.comment:
This case is absurdly good, especially for the money. Very easy to build with, very small, looks great, works great.
The slight upgrade is a NCase M2 grater, but that's $380 after shipping and the required accessory for vertical mounting the GPU. It's really hard to justify the 3.5x price for the NCase.
reviews.author: Rick Anderson

reviews.title: Great case!
reviews.comment: I love this case way more than I expected.  I run a gigabyte rtx 5070 ti gpu and an amd 9950x3d cpu.  Cool it with a nzxt z63 Kraken cpu cooler.  Great fit.  It’s tight but good.  Looks great!
